LABEL: atrium of lateral ventricle
Definition: A brain ventricle that is the region of the lateral ventricle at the junction where the body meets the inferior horn and posterior horn, characterized by an enlarged choroid plexus known as the choroid glomus.

LABEL: body of hippocampus
Definition: A regional part of the brain that is the middle portion of Ammon's horn (hippocampus proper), extending from the head to the tail along the floor of the lateral ventricle.

LABEL: extended amygdala
Definition: A regional part of brain involved in reward cognition, defined by its distinctive connectivity and neurochemical staining patterns, comprising the central medial amygdala, sublenticular substantia innominata, and bed nucleus of the stria terminalis.

LABEL: frontomarginal gyrus
Definition: A gyrus that is part of the polar region of the frontal lobe, located at the most anterior aspect of the cerebral hemisphere.

LABEL: head of hippocampus
Definition: A regional part of the brain that is the expanded anterior portion of Ammon's horn (hippocampus proper), located near the base of the temporal lobe and bordering the medial surface of the lateral ventricle.

LABEL: occipitoparietal transition region
Definition: A regional part of the cerebral hemisphere located at the anatomical boundary between the occipital lobe and the parietal lobe, representing cortical areas that transition between these two lobar divisions.

LABEL: occipitotemporal transition region
Definition: A regional part of the cerebral hemisphere located at the anatomical boundary between the occipital lobe and the temporal lobe, representing cortical areas that transition between these two lobar divisions.
